headline: ETF After-Market News | Surging Again Within the “Light”! Chinext AI ETF Huabao (159363) Underlying Index Rises Another 3%! AI Computing Demand Soars, Capital Keeps Pouring In
summary: Chinext artificial intelligence stocks extended their rally on Friday, with Xingchen Technology up over 11%. Optical module maker Xinyisheng rose 4.87%, and the underlying index of the Huabao ETF gained another 3%.
why: The ChiNext board is Shenzhen's growth-oriented exchange, and its AI and technology constituents are sensitive to sentiment on AI computing demand.
why_moved: Rising demand for AI computing and continued capital inflows into the sector were cited as drivers of the rally.
